nativeBaseline.reference: ul/ol containing li items; ordered lists retain sequence and native numbering; noninteractive list structure

interaction.keyboard: native controls only; no list-owned arrow-key or selection model
interaction.focus: native DOM order, no List or ListItem focus management
interaction.directionality: logical inline/block properties; RTL follows host direction

library: Preserve ul/ol and li semantics, order, and nested interactive controls
Provide token-backed list variants, inline gutters, logical indentation, inset separators, row sizing, spacing and inherited density
Never imply selection, navigation or activation from visual row styling
consumer: Author localized labels and meaningful row content
Provide actual Button/Link/Checkbox etc for actions, with their own semantic disabled/checked/busy states
Own filtering, loading, pagination, empty/error states, data operations, and destination routing

profileVariability: inherited comfortable/compact, RTL, forced-colors, responsive wrapping
gutter auto/none/sm/md/lg, indent none/sm/md/lg, dividerInset none/gutter, opt-in sticky native headings
notes: List is not Listbox, Menu, Tree, navigation, or a selection/roving-focus widget.
No row-level selected, disabled, active, loading, or clickable props. Reuse actual interactive components inside rows.
Use an empty authored list only when its visible empty state is supplied outside the list.
Grouped lists use real headings outside ul/ol and named nested lists; sticky positioning depends on scroll scope and explicit offset.
